hydration_tip: Aim for roughly 2.9 L of fluids across the day (about 12 glasses of 250 ml), and more in hot weather or when you exercise. Water is best; unsweetened drinks such as lemon water or herbal tea also count. Individual needs vary.
tips: Eat slowly and stop when you feel comfortably full.
High-fibre foods such as vegetables, legumes and whole grains help you stay full.
Limit sugary drinks and deep-fried snacks; keep regular meal times.
Always check ingredient labels for your listed allergens; recipes and brands vary.
